hints.content: To find the image of $\triangle ABC$ under the dilation, we can dilate all of $\triangle ABC$'s vertices and connect them.

For example, point $\blueD C$ is $8$ units to the right of $A$ and $8$ units down, so its image is $\goldD{\dfrac14}\cdot8=2$ units to the right and $\goldD{\dfrac14}\cdot 8=2$ units down from $A$.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: Triangle A B C. Point B is twelve units to the right of point A and four units up, Point C is eight units right from point A and down eight units. There is a dashed line to highlight horizontally the eight units right and vertically eight units down from point A. There is also a dashed line to highlight horizontally two units to the right and vertically two units down from point A.  There is another plotted point that is two unit right and two units down from Point A.

hints.content:
Let's do the same thing with the remaining vertices.

Since our scale factor is $\goldD{\dfrac14}$, every side length in $\triangle A'B'C'$ will be $\dfrac{1}{4}$ the length of the corresponding side in $\triangle ABC$.

Another way to think about it is that since our scale factor is closer to $0$ than to $1$, every point in the image will be closer to our center $A$ than to its corresponding point in the pre-image.

Connecting the vertices of the image, we get the following mapping:



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: Triangle A B C. Point B is twelve units to the right of point A and four units up, Point C is eight units right from point A and down eight units. There is another triangle graphed that is triangle A B C with a scale factor of one fourth from point A. The new triangle the Point B prime is three units to the right of point A and one unit up, Point C prime is two units right from point A and down two units. Point A prime is mapped onto point A. The distance between C prime and B prime is approximately three point two units. The distance between C prime and A prime is two point eight units. The distance between A prime and B prime is approximately three point two units.

question.content:
**Draw the image of $\triangle ABC$ under a dilation whose center is $A$ and scale factor is $\dfrac{1}{4}$.**
